settings::settings-languages.purpose: Manage the languages supported by the platform.
steps: View the list of currently supported languages.
Click 'Add Language' to enable a new language.
Enter the language code and name.

settings::settings-companies.purpose: Manage multiple companies or entities within the system.
steps: Click 'Add Company' to create a new profile.

settings::settings-currency.purpose: Manage active currencies and exchange rate rules.
steps: Click 'Add Currency' to include a new one.

settings::settings-users.purpose: Manage user accounts, roles, and permissions.
steps: Click 'Add User' to invite or create a new user.

settings::settings-emailtemplates.purpose: Configure the automated email templates sent by the system.
steps: Select a template to edit or click 'Add Template'.
Update the subject and body using available placeholders.

settings::settings-translations.purpose: Manage UI text translations for all supported languages.
steps: Update the text values for specific keys.

settings::settings-translationcoverage.purpose: Review missing translations across the system.
steps: View the completeness percentage for each language.
Click 'Missing Report' to see untranslated keys.

settings::settings-reminders.purpose: Configure automated system reminders and alerts.
steps: Set the condition, trigger, and message.

settings::settings-certstatus.purpose: Manage the possible statuses for bank certificates.

settings::settings-goldsettings.purpose: Configure global settings related to gold assets, such as purities and types.
steps: Use the tabs to switch between Types and Purities.
Click 'Add' to create a new entry.

settings::settings-dashboard.purpose: Customize the administrator dashboard layout and metrics.
steps: Toggle the widgets you want to display.

settings::settings-banks.purpose: Manage the list of banks available in the system.

settings::settings-backuprestore.purpose: Create and manage system backups, or restore from a previous backup.
steps: Navigate to Settings > Backup and Restore.
Click 'Create Backup' to take a new snapshot.
To restore, select a backup and click 'Restore'.

settings::settings-documentation.purpose: Generate system documentation, user guides, and technical manuals automatically.
steps: Select the Language, Theme, and Device options.
Click 'Generate User Guide' or other specific guides.
Wait for the live progress to complete.
